Procheck - Windows test build
==============================

This is a self-contained web build of Procheck. Flutter's web output can't
be opened by double-clicking index.html (browsers block it for security
reasons), so it needs to be served by a tiny local web server first - then
you can install it as a real desktop app.

STEP 1 - Unzip
--------------
Unzip this folder anywhere on your PC.

STEP 2 - Start the local server
--------------------------------
Double-click "Run Procheck.bat" in this folder.
A black window will open and stay running - leave it open.

(If it says Python isn't found: install Python from python.org, or if you
have Node.js installed, open a terminal in this folder and run
"npx serve ." instead, then use whatever port it prints.)

STEP 3 - Open it and install it as an app
------------------------------------------
Open Edge or Chrome and go to:

    http://localhost:8765

Once it loads, look in the address bar for an install icon (a little
computer-with-arrow icon on the right side), or open the browser's "..."
menu -> Apps -> Install this site as an app.

That creates a real app window (no browser tabs/toolbar) with its own
taskbar icon and Start Menu entry, just like a native app. You can pin it
to your taskbar or Start Menu from there.

Notes
-----
- Your checklists/folders/templates are saved locally in the browser
  profile you installed it from (via IndexedDB) - they'll persist between
  launches as long as you don't clear that site's data.
- To stop the local server, go back to the "Run Procheck.bat" window and
  press Ctrl+C.
- This is a test build for trying the app out. A genuine native Windows
  .exe build is also possible later, but has to be compiled on a Windows
  machine with Flutter + Visual Studio's C++ build tools installed.
